notes: Perplexity first-party Decisions API price: "The Decisions API costs $0.02 per million input tokens. Output tokens are free, and there is no per-request fee." (quickstart; the pricing page JSON also shows decisions.input 0.02). Rate limit 10 requests per second per organization on every plan. PRICE CONFLICT: OpenRouter and Requesty list the same model at $0.04 per million input tokens (2x the direct price). Unresolved whether the routers add a markup or the direct price changed; both are recorded (see the openrouter and requesty pricing docs). pplx-decider-v1.1-27b is served under the same API; the v1 and v1.1 rows are the same rate. Cache fields: cache_read_per_m and cache_write_per_m are null with cache_rates_status "not_published": the vendor documents no caching discount or surcharge, so no cache rate is recorded (none is inferred from the input price).

pplx-decider-v1-27b.notes: Direct price. 10 requests/s per org. Requesty measured a billed $0.023 per 1,000 items (about $0.02) on its gateway benchmark through the router.

pplx-decider-v1.1-27b.notes: Same Decisions API; the quickstart does not list a separate v1.1 rate.
